coordinate_system.view_note: When viewed from the peg tip toward the flange (looking along +Z), positive right-handed yaw appears clockwise.

tool_reference.note: The ATI measurement origin is above this plane and must be measured after the white flange is included.

integrated_tool.architecture: one-piece blue flange, short rigid root, and size-specific hex peg
integrated_tool.swap_method: manually unbolt and replace the complete flange-tool
integrated_tool.note: The root is solid and self-supporting when the sensor-side flange face is placed on the build plate. All three tools keep the same Z=-42 mm tip datum.

retired_quick_change_v1_3.reason: The split cartridge shoulders required support and printed poorly; manual whole-flange exchange is simpler and removes receiver, fit, and clip uncertainty.

local_interference_ribs.note: Three short sacrificial FDM ribs remove play; they are not the positive retention feature.

tool_free_retaining_clip.recommended_material: PETG or unfilled PA; print the clip flat and keep spare clips
tool_free_retaining_clip.note: The U-clip is a positive pull-out stop. The rigid shoulder remains the only Z/tilt datum.

peg.yaw_alignment_reference: Rotate the complete hex peg from the legacy +X-flat construction so that one selected flat normal is +45 deg in the pink-flange CAD frame, parallel to the B/C tangent datum on the central R36 outer cylindrical surface.

simulation_exact.purpose: strict source control; use bit_tip_scale and bit_tip_chamfer_m from each MuJoCo source JSON

hardware_easy_v2.purpose: recommended physical FDM tip; a visible 45-degree chamfer paired with the hardware-easy-v2 socket funnel
hardware_easy_v2.claim_boundary: The chamfer expands the geometric guiding region but does not guarantee capture under friction, tilt, burrs, or multi-point contact. Hardware-specific simulation and terminal-gate retuning are required.

exterior_vertical_ribs.note: Nut-like vertical ribs begin below a 2 mm smooth top band; the MuJoCo exterior side mesh is visual-only, while the physical top rim remains unchanged.

simulation_exact.purpose: research control; exactly reproduces the MuJoCo wall AF, 45-degree entry chamfer, and top AF

hardware_easy_v2.purpose: recommended hardware target after the first physical print; larger straight-wall clearance, a visibly larger 45-degree entry funnel, and a proportionally larger outer head
hardware_easy_v2.claim_boundary: This is an intentional hardware engineering bias, not strict nominal sim-to-real geometry. It increases capture tolerance but also increases rotational free play before wall torque contact. All compared hardware methods must use the same fixture, and a hardware-specific MuJoCo profile and terminal-gate retuning are required for matched reruns.
